_help: AV Lab video visualiser playlist. Each video fills one letter key (max 26, QWERTY order). Video audio is used by default; the transport audio-source toggle switches to Jukebox audio and mutes the video. Shader overlays are off by default and can be toggled on; when Jukebox audio is selected, the overlay can react to its audio. 'videos' entries: id (11-character YouTube ID), title, optional effect (a name from 'effects'; default cycles through the list) and optional start (seconds). Effects: file (GLSL under /video-effects/ outputting premultiplied RGBA with iTime, iResolution, iMouse, iAudio), blend (CSS mix-blend-mode), speed, and filter amounts applied to the video at full level (hue degrees from mid, saturate from overall, contrast and brightness from bass, scale from bass). Refresh 'videos' from the channel with: npm run videos:sync (or the Sync YouTube videos workflow). Hand-edited effect, start and title values are kept.
